name: 24604-random1k-8b-2gpu
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3 of ONE a3 node (--gres=gpu:2), NVLink between them.
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine, one node.
load_profile: poisson (open loop), rate=10 requests/s, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 1000 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, seed static 24604.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, single turn, fixed 1024 prompt tokens / 128 output tokens (min == max == mean on both), greedy `temperature: 0.0`, every request generating exactly 128 tokens.
purpose: A Llama-class chat assistant answering single-turn thousand-word prompts at ten requests per second on two linked GPUs.
launch:
# The engine's command line for this item, declared once and used unchanged.
#
# FORMAT: `key: value` lines only, a value beginning `{` or `[` is read as JSON, and every line
# is truncated at `#`. So `compilation-config` below must stay on ONE line and contain no `#`.

model: RedHatAI/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-FP8
tensor-parallel-size: 2
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
enable-prefix-caching: false
kv-cache-dtype: fp8
compilation-config: {"mode": 3, "custom_ops": ["none"], "splitting_ops": [], "cudagraph_mode": "FULL_DECODE_ONLY", "pass_config": {"enable_attn_fusion": true, "enable_fi_allreduce_fusion": true, "enable_noop": true}}
disable-custom-all-reduce: true
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-model-len: 2048
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
dtype: bfloat16
